parameters.formDescription:
Review an AI-generated supplier dispute email before it is sent.

Verify the supplier, invoice, email content, and dispute details before approving or rejecting the communication.

Approved emails may proceed to the controlled sending stage. Rejected emails will not be sent.

All review decisions are recorded in the ProcureGuard audit trail.

values.formSubmittedText: Supplier email review submitted successfully. ProcureGuard AI will process and record your decision.

parameters.query:
SELECT
    -- Email approval
    ap.id AS email_approval_id,
    ap.organization_id,
    ap.anomaly_id,
    ap.invoice_id,
    ap.approval_type,
    ap.status AS approval_status,
    ap.requested_by,
    ap.requested_at,
    ap.expires_at,

    -- Exact linked draft
    d.id AS draft_id,
    d.approval_id AS supplier_dispute_approval_id,
    d.recipient_email,
    d.email_subject,
    d.email_body,
    d.status AS draft_status,
    d.generated_by,
    d.created_at AS draft_created_at,

    -- Anomaly
    a.anomaly_type,
    a.severity,
    a.status AS anomaly_status,
    a.estimated_financial_impact,
    a.description AS anomaly_description,

    -- Invoice
    i.invoice_number,
    i.invoice_date,
    i.currency,
    i.total AS invoice_total,
    i.processing_status,

    -- Supplier
    s.id AS supplier_id,
    s.supplier_code,
    s.supplier_name,
    s.contact_name AS supplier_contact_name,
    s.email AS supplier_database_email,

    -- Human form decision
    $2::text AS reviewer_name,
    $3::text AS review_decision,
    $4::text AS review_notes

FROM public.approvals ap

JOIN public.supplier_dispute_drafts d
    ON d.email_approval_id = ap.id
   AND d.organization_id = ap.organization_id

JOIN public.anomalies a
    ON a.id = ap.anomaly_id
   AND a.organization_id = ap.organization_id

JOIN public.invoices i
    ON i.id = ap.invoice_id
   AND i.organization_id = ap.organization_id

JOIN public.suppliers s
    ON s.id = d.supplier_id
   AND s.organization_id = ap.organization_id

WHERE ap.id = $1::uuid
  AND ap.approval_type = 'SUPPLIER_EMAIL'
  AND ap.status = 'PENDING'
  AND d.status = 'PENDING_REVIEW';

WITH updated_approval AS (
    UPDATE public.approvals
    SET
        status = 'APPROVED',
        decided_by = $4::text,
        decided_at = NOW(),
        decision_notes = $5::text,

        organization_id,
        anomaly_id,
        invoice_id,

        decided_by,
        decided_at,

),

updated_draft AS (
    UPDATE public.supplier_dispute_drafts d
    SET
        status = 'APPROVED',
        reviewed_by = $4::text,
        reviewed_at = NOW(),
        updated_at = NOW()
    FROM updated_approval ap
    WHERE d.id = $3::uuid
      AND d.email_approval_id = ap.id
      AND d.organization_id = ap.organization_id
      AND d.status = 'PENDING_REVIEW'
    RETURNING
        d.id,
        d.organization_id,
        d.approval_id,
        d.email_approval_id,
        d.anomaly_id,
        d.invoice_id,
        d.supplier_id,
        d.recipient_email,
        d.email_subject,
        d.email_body,
        d.status,
        d.generated_by,
        d.reviewed_by,
        d.reviewed_at,
        d.sent_at,
        d.created_at,
        d.updated_at
)

SELECT

    d.organization_id,
    d.approval_id AS supplier_dispute_approval_id,
    d.email_approval_id,
    d.anomaly_id,
    d.invoice_id,

    d.reviewed_at,

FROM updated_draft d
JOIN updated_approval ap
    ON ap.id = d.email_approval_id;

parameters.query:
SELECT
    d.id AS draft_id,
    d.organization_id,
    d.email_approval_id,
    d.approval_id AS supplier_dispute_approval_id,
    d.anomaly_id,
    d.invoice_id,
    d.supplier_id,

    d.recipient_email,
    d.email_subject,
    d.email_body,
    d.status AS draft_status,
    d.reviewed_by,
    d.reviewed_at,
    d.sent_at,

    ap.status AS email_approval_status,
    ap.decided_by,
    ap.decided_at,

    s.supplier_name,
    s.email AS supplier_database_email,

    CASE
        WHEN d.status <> 'APPROVED'
            THEN 'DRAFT_NOT_APPROVED'

        WHEN ap.status <> 'APPROVED'
            THEN 'EMAIL_APPROVAL_NOT_APPROVED'

        WHEN d.sent_at IS NOT NULL
            THEN 'ALREADY_SENT'

        WHEN d.recipient_email IS NULL
          OR btrim(d.recipient_email) = ''
            THEN 'MISSING_RECIPIENT'

        WHEN lower(btrim(d.recipient_email))
             <> lower(btrim(s.email))
            THEN 'RECIPIENT_MISMATCH'

        WHEN d.email_subject IS NULL
          OR btrim(d.email_subject) = ''
            THEN 'MISSING_SUBJECT'

        WHEN d.email_body IS NULL
          OR btrim(d.email_body) = ''
            THEN 'MISSING_BODY'

        WHEN lower(btrim(d.recipient_email)) LIKE '%.example'
            THEN 'TEST_DOMAIN'

        ELSE 'READY_TO_SEND'
    END AS send_validation_status

FROM public.supplier_dispute_drafts d

JOIN public.approvals ap
    ON ap.id = d.email_approval_id
   AND ap.organization_id = d.organization_id

JOIN public.suppliers s
    ON s.id = d.supplier_id
   AND s.organization_id = d.organization_id

WHERE d.id = $1::uuid
  AND d.organization_id = $2::uuid
  AND d.email_approval_id = $3::uuid
  AND ap.approval_type = 'SUPPLIER_EMAIL';
